Potty Training.title: Puppy Potty Training
Potty Training.intro: Potty training is the first big job with a new puppy. These guides cover schedules by age, how long it takes, what to do when your puppy will not pee outside, and why accidents can start again. Each one is sourced and written for first-time owners.

Sleep & Crate.title: Puppy Sleep and Crate Training
Sleep & Crate.seoTitle: Puppy Sleep and Crate Training Guides
Sleep & Crate.intro: Crying at night, the first night home, crate size and nap schedules. Read these guides to set up a calm sleeping routine, introduce the crate kindly, and know what is normal for a young puppy.

Preparation.title: Getting Ready for a New Puppy
Preparation.intro: Checklists, essentials and a first-week plan for people bringing a puppy home. Use them to buy what you really need, prepare the house, and handle the first days with less stress.

Training.title: Puppy Training Basics
Training.intro: First commands, socialization and a realistic schedule if you work full time. Short, positive training that fits into daily life and builds good habits from week one.

Behavior.title: Puppy Behavior Problems
Behavior.seoTitle: Puppy Behavior: Barking, Zoomies and Separation Anxiety
Behavior.intro: Barking, zoomies, separation anxiety and other things that make new owners worry. Learn what is normal, why puppies do it, and calm ways to respond without scolding.

Biting & Teething.title: Puppy Biting and Teething
Biting & Teething.intro: Sharp teeth, sore gums and chewed shoes. These guides explain the teething timeline, what puppies can safely chew, how to stop biting with the pause, redirect and reward method, and when biting usually eases.

Health & Development.title: Puppy Health and Development
Health & Development.seoTitle: Puppy Health, Vaccines and Development Stages
Health & Development.intro: What to expect at each age, from the vaccination schedule to development stages between 8 weeks and 6 months. General information to help you plan vet visits and ask better questions.
